questions.question: What is the SI unit of intensity of sound?
questions.solution: Decibel is measurement unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

questions.question: Doldrums pressure belts lies in between which of the following latitudes?
questions.solution: A Doldrums pressure belt refers to those parts of the Atlantic Ocean and the Pacific Ocean affected by the low-pressure area around the equator where the prevailing winds are calm.

questions.question: What is an exothermic reaction?

options.text: Reaction in which heat is released.
Reaction in which heat is absorbed.
Reaction in which neither heat is released nor absorbed.

questions.solution: An exothermic reaction is a chemical or physical reaction that releases heat. It gives net energy to its surroundings needed to initiate the reaction is less than the energy released.

questions.question: Which colour is formed when Blue and Green are mixed?
questions.solution: Cyan is the colour which is greenish blue in nature and is obtained by mixing green and blue. It has a wavelength in the range of 490-520 nanometre.

questions.question: India recently notified the Third protocol to amend Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement with which of the following countries?
questions.solution: India notified the Third Protocol amending the existing India-Singapore Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement on 23rd March-2017. It provides for residence based taxation of capital gains of shares in a company.

questions.question: Which component in tobacco makes it harmful for human consumption?
questions.solution: Nicotine is the stimulant found in tobacco and is addictive in nature. The long term use of nicotine increases the risk of cardio-vascular diseases and also cancer.

questions.question: MTNL comes under which of the following category?
questions.solution: MTNL is a Navratna company. A Navratna is company with A score of 60 which is based on six indices like net profit, net worth, total manpower cost etc.

questions.question: Which among the following is national water animal of India?
questions.solution: Gangetic Dolphin was notified as the national water animal of India in 2010. It inhabits the Ganges Brahmaputra-Meghna and Kamaphuli-Sangu river systems of Nepal, India, and Bangladesh.

questions.question: Who amongst the following is a renowned vocalist?
questions.solution: Pandit Jasraj is an Indian classical singer and belongs to the Mewati gharana. He has been awarded Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan for his contributions to Indian classical music.

questions.question: In computer terminology, what is the full form of FTP?
questions.solution: File Transfer Protocol (FTP) is a program for uploading and downloading files, typically those that are too big and would take too long to download via a regular email program as an attachment.

questions.question: What are the main components of Brass Alloy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e __**Copper and Zinc**__

 
• Brass is an alloy that is made of copper and zinc.
 
• Their flow characteristics make it a relatively easy material to cast.
 
• An alloy is considered a homogeneous mixture because, by definition, a homogeneous mixture has the same uniform appearance and composition throughout.
 
• Since an alloy is a mixture of two or more metals or a mixture of a metal with some other element, and these mixtures are uniform throughout, they fit the definition of being homogeneous.

questions.question: Alveoli are related to which of the following system of human body?
questions.solution: Alveoli are the cavities found in the lungs which are the basic unit of ventilation. These cavities are particularly found in mammals and are the sites for gas exchange.

questions.question: Which emperor wrote the play 'Nagananda' in Sanskrit language?
questions.solution: Nagananda is a Sanskrit play written by Harshavardhana who belonged to the Pushyabhuti dynasty and ruled from 606 C.E. to 648 C.E.

questions.question: What was invented by J. B. Dunlop?
questions.solution: J.B. Dunlop is credited with inventing the pneumatic tyre that was first used in bicycles. The patent for it was granted to him on 7th December, 1888.

questions.question: Which of the following right has been removed from fundamental rights and converted to a simple legal right?

options.text: Right to life and personal liberty

questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**Right to property**__.

__
 
• Right to Property was removed as a Fundamental right and made a legal right as per the **44th Amendment Act, 1978**. It is now enshrined in Article **300A** of the Constitution of India.
 
• There are six Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution and they are as follows:
 
 
• Right to equality
 
• Right to freedom
 
• Right against exploitation
 
• Right to freedom of religion
 
• Cultural and educational right
 
• Right to constitutional remedies
